reason: E1 states that Si-containing additives facilitate consolidation, improve oxidation resistance, and enhance mechanical properties of transition metal borides, supporting the first three premises. However, neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence for the specific mechanisms of transient liquid-phase sintering at ~1700 °C or the in-situ formation of a protective silica scale from Si-rich intergranular films in ZrB2; these remain unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Si-containing additives facilitate consolidation of difficult-to-sinter boride powders
Si-containing additives improve oxidation resistance of boride ceramics
Si-containing additives improve mechanical properties of boride ceramics
Transient liquid-phase sintering can be induced by Si additive at ~1700 °C
Si-rich intergranular films oxidize to a protective silica scale during service
